narrative.executive_summary: Live scan of 11 missions across retail_clothing detected no CRITICAL threats but reveals a systemic operational risk pattern: 10 MEDIUM and 1 LOW severity findings. The dominant vector is a systemic reorder logic failure — 77 products flagged for immediate replenishment with 0 units recommended — creating imminent stockout and lost-sales exposure. This is compounded by acute demand concentration in 36 high-velocity SKUs led by Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30), and Mouse (28), and profit concentration where a single SKU (Mouse: ₹39,496 profit, 29.49% margin) drives ~25% of total profit (₹152,500-₹162,180).

threat_vectors.name: Systemic Reorder Point Calibration Failure
threat_vectors.description: Four missions flagged 77 products requiring immediate replenishment (21 + 36 + 13 + 7) yet system recommends 0 units reorder volume. Indicates broken replenishment logic risking widespread stockouts and revenue loss if not manually overridden.

threat_vectors.name: High-Velocity Demand Concentration & Stockout Exposure
threat_vectors.description: 36 high-velocity products identified, led by Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30 units), and Mouse (28 units). Failure to proactively buffer these top movers threatens fulfillment continuity and customer retention.

threat_vectors.name: Profit Concentration & Supplier Cost Fragility
threat_vectors.description: Mouse alone generates ₹39,496.35 at 29.49% margin, representing ~24-26% of total portfolio profit (₹152,500 on ₹466,989 sales and ₹162,180 on ₹505,881 sales). Over-reliance on one SKU creates single-point-of-failure to price or supplier cost shocks.

immediate_actions: Within 24 hours, manually audit and override reorder calculations for all 77 flagged products (Aging Inventory 21, Color Trend 36, Ghost Inventory 13, Phantom Depletion 7) and issue emergency purchase orders for top 5 velocity SKUs: Oil, Biscuits, Mouse, Sugar (23 units).
Place safety-stock buffer of 14-21 days cover on Oil (42 units) and Biscuits (30 units) immediately to prevent stockout of highest-demand items.
Conduct margin stress-test and supplier cost review on Mouse and top 15 profit contributors within 72 hours to validate 29.49% margin sustainability and identify alternative sourcing.
Freeze automated markdowns on aging inventory until reorder logic is recalibrated and validated against actual velocity data.
monitoring_recommendations: Deploy daily automated reconciliation dashboard comparing flagged replenishment needs vs. system-recommended volume to detect 0-unit anomalies in real time.
Implement weekly profit-concentration and demand-volatility tracking for top 36 SKUs, with alerts if any single SKU exceeds 20% of total profit or velocity shifts >15% week-over-week.
Establish weekly review of new launch performance (Kids Zone: 27 units, ₹35,156 of ₹79,535 total) against velocity benchmarks to catch launch failure early.
